name: gen_personal_email_airport_pickup
task: A person dictates a personal email to a friend about airport pickup and weekend plans.

turns.say: okay so, write an email to jess. subject, quick favor for friday.
start with, hi jess comma hope your week is going okay.
new paragraph. i'm landing on friday, august ninth at six fifteen pm at laguardia.
could you pick me up at terminal b around six forty five? no wait, make that seven fifteen.
also, my checked bag fee was forty five dollars, which is ridiculous. scratch that, don't say ridiculous.
new paragraph. make that a list. things i can bring: the camping stove, extra flashlights, and the snacks.
change extra flashlights to two lanterns. and add one more item: bug spray.
close with, thanks again exclamation point. see you soon comma alex.

judge.criteria: Final document is a clean personal email with the stated subject, converted dates/times/prices, a bullet list of at least four items including 'two lanterns', and excludes retracted/command text.
